free_tier_limits: Free public access is subject to endpoint constraints: daily point requests allow up to 20 parameters, regional requests allow one parameter, and repeated requests for the same relative location may be blocked.
rate_limits: No per-minute quota is published. NASA advises no more than five concurrent requests; excessive synchronous requests may be blocked, and HTTP 429 is documented.
